## Summary & Core Mission

Thomas Cherickal trains individuals, freshers, developers, corporate teams, engineering managers, and CXOs to build, inspect, and deploy production-grade AI agent teams. All engagements are delivered 100% remote worldwide across 195 countries (4 hours per day, Monday through Friday; weekends are holidays), with every technical architecture, prompt pipeline, and code sample verified in isolated sandboxes before delivery.

---

## Authoritative Offers, Pricing & Purchasing Power Parity (PPP)

All pricing below is rendered deterministically from `data/pricing.json` and `data/tiers.json` across 6 global Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) tiers (Tier 1: 100%, Tier 2: 75%, Tier 3: 50%, Tier 4 Startups: 50%, Tier 5 Universities & Non-Profits: 25%, Tier 6 UN LDCs & Relief: Custom). When a country appears in both Tier 3 and Tier 6, Tier 6 takes precedence.

- **Business AI Training Flagship**: <!--ssot:fmt.tier_price_list(flagship-business-training)-->$1,000 / $750 / $500 / $500 / $250 / Custom<!--/ssot--> USD for <!--ssot:fmt.duration_phrase(flagship-business-training)-->2 calendar months (includes weekends as holidays)<!--/ssot--> (30 days live engineering training + 30 calendar days dedicated support included at $0 extra charge). Covers <!--ssot:fmt.seats_phrase(flagship-business-training)-->up to 10 participants (+$100 per extra seat, max 20)<!--/ssot--> (extra seats scaled by PPP). Quarterly cap: <!--ssot:fmt.quarterly_cap_phrase()-->2 flagship cohorts per quarter<!--/ssot-->.
- **Personal AI Training Flagship**: <!--ssot:fmt.tier_price_list(flagship-personal-training)-->$1,000 / $750 / $500 / $500 / $250 / Custom<!--/ssot--> USD for <!--ssot:fmt.duration_phrase(flagship-personal-training)-->2 calendar months (includes weekends as holidays)<!--/ssot--> (30 days live personal training + 30 calendar days dedicated support included at $0 extra charge). Covers <!--ssot:fmt.seats_phrase(flagship-personal-training)-->up to 10 participants (+$100 per extra seat, max 20)<!--/ssot-->.
- **Business Service Picks (16 Standalone Services)**: <!--ssot:fmt.tier_price_list(individual-service-business)-->$100 / $75 / $50 / $50 / $25 / Custom<!--/ssot--> USD for <!--ssot:fmt.duration_phrase(individual-service-business)-->10 calendar days (includes weekends as holidays)<!--/ssot-->. Covers <!--ssot:fmt.seats_phrase(individual-service-business)-->up to 10 participants (+$100 per extra seat, max 20)<!--/ssot-->.
- **Personal Service Picks (16 Standalone Services)**: <!--ssot:fmt.tier_price_list(individual-service-personal)-->$100 / $75 / $50 / $50 / $25 / Custom<!--/ssot--> USD for <!--ssot:fmt.duration_phrase(individual-service-personal)-->10 calendar days (includes weekends as holidays)<!--/ssot-->. Covers <!--ssot:fmt.seats_phrase(individual-service-personal)-->up to 10 participants (+$100 per extra seat, max 20)<!--/ssot-->.
- **Payment Structure & Guarantees**: Strictly **$0 upfront**, billed in <!--ssot:fmt.installment_phrase(flagship-business-training)-->10 equal installments of 10%<!--/ssot--> due strictly after completed milestone blocks (Days 5-50 for Flagships; Days 1-10 for Service Picks). Includes the **Walkaway Guarantee** (walk away owing nothing more than already paid after any milestone, including the first) and **Apache 2.0 Licensing** with 100% client IP ownership.
